faqs.question: Will it help remove tan on the body?
faqs.answer: This will help reduce acne marks but won't work immediately  for tan.

faqs.question: Can this be used for sensitive skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have formulated this lotion, keeping in mind all skin types, including sensitive skin. It doesn't contain ingredients that can irritate or inflame your skin. Instead, it helps soothe and calm skin.

faqs.question: Will it leave my skin sticky?
faqs.answer: No, this lightweight formula absorbs very quickly into the skin. This won't leave your skin sticky.

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be used it the morning and night. We recommend using at least once daily but can be used more frequently as well

faqs.question: Can I help mask body odour?
faqs.answer: No, this lotion won't help mask body odour.

faqs.question: What does Niacinamide do for skin?
faqs.answer: The topical application of Niacinamide helps repair the protective layer of the skin. It promotes the production of ceramides and elastin. Over time it helps reduce melanin transfer to outer layer of skin, which helps fade marks.

faqs.question: How do I stop body acne?
faqs.answer: Try including Be Bodywise 1% Salicylic Acid Body Wash along with AHA and BHA based gels or sprays. Use this moisturiser post that and it should help you. For severe concerns consult an expert!

faqs.question: Can I use the Niacinamide Body Lotion with other body Lotions?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can alternatively use Niacinamide Body Lotion. If you use Niacinamide Body Lotion in the morning, you can use the other one in the night.

faqs.question: Does showering help with body acne?
faqs.answer: Yes. Regular showering helps remove impurities. Cold showers help control sebum control and prevent new breakouts.

faqs.question: Will the Niacinamide Lotion help with Butt acne scar?
faqs.answer: No. This lotion won't help with butt acne scar.
